messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: If you have liver disease, small changes in fluid and salt balance can trigger a serious complication.
The complication is called hepatic coma.
Your doctor will monitor your kidney function and watch for changes in alertness.
Sudden vision changes need urgent care:
Rarely, hydrochlorothiazide causes sudden short-sightedness (acute myopia).
It also causes a sharp rise in pressure inside the eye (acute angle-closure glaucoma).
These side effects usually occur within hours to weeks of starting the medicine.
Stop taking Hydrochlorothiazide and get medical help immediately if your vision drops suddenly.
Stop taking Hydrochlorothiazide and get medical help immediately if your eye hurts.
Left untreated, acute angle-closure glaucoma can cause permanent loss of vision.
A history of allergy to sulfa medicines or penicillin may increase the risk.
Blood sugar, cholesterol, uric acid and calcium:
Hydrochlorothiazide can raise blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, uric acid and calcium.
Your diabetes medicine or insulin dose may need adjusting.
Triples: [["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "hepatic coma"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "sudden short-sightedness"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "acute angle-closure glaucoma"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "sudden vision changes"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "eye pain"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "acute myopia"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "increased blood sugar"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "increased cholesterol"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "increased triglycerides"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "increased uric acid"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has side effect", "increased calcium"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "stop taking and get medical help immediately if vision drops suddenly"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "stop taking and get medical help immediately if eye hurts"], ["acute angle-closure glaucoma", "has consequence", "permanent loss of vision"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "monitor kidney function"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "watch for changes in alertness"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has administration instruction", "adjust diabetes medicine or insulin dose"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has warning", "sudden vision changes need urgent care"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has warning", "side effects usually occur within hours to weeks of starting the medicine"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has contraindicated in", "liver disease"], ["Hydrochlorothiazide (HCTZ)", "has warning", "history of allergy to sulfa medicines or penicillin may increase the risk"]]
Relations: ["has administration instruction", "has consequence", "has contraindicated in", "has side effect", "has warning"]
Answer:

completion:
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the specific action or monitoring specified by the object entity to be followed by the patient or healthcare provider.  
has consequence: The object entity is a potential outcome or complication that can result from the subject condition or event.  
has contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.  
has side effect: The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or reaction specified by the object entity.  
has warning: The subject drug is associated with the caution or risk specified by the object entity that patients or healthcare providers should be aware of.
